DataSource.query:
begin 
SELECT substring(cast([SEQ_MONTH] as varchar(6)), 1, 4) as annee,
	   substring(cast([SEQ_MONTH] as varchar(6)), 5, 2) as mois
      ,currs.COD_CURRENCY as curr_frm
	  ,currt.COD_CURRENCY as curr_to
      ,[EXCHANGE_RATE] as curr_rate
  FROM [KUHN_BI_DWH].[UTILITY].[FACT_EXCHANGE_RATE_UTIL] exc
  left outer join common.dim_currency currs on exc.SEQ_SOURCE_CURRENCY = currs.SEQ_CURRENCY
  left outer join common.dim_currency currt on exc.SEQ_TARGET_CURRENCY = currt.SEQ_CURRENCY
  where currs.cod_currency = 'E'
end
